units.source_text: “我根本没打算把K对我的表白告诉夫人。

en.t: I had absolutely no intention of telling Madam what K had confessed to me.

units.source_text: 随后又对自己这样撒谎感到不快，

en.t: But then I felt uneasy about having lied like that,

units.source_text: 我只好又说：‘K没有托我跟夫人说什么，我要谈的不是关于K的事。’

en.t: so I had to add, 'K did not ask me to tell you anything, Madam. What I want to discuss is not about K.'

units.source_text: ‘是吗。’夫人说道，等着我说下去。

en.t: 'Is that so?' Madam said, waiting for me to continue.

units.source_text: 我无论如何必须开口了。

en.t: I had to speak, no matter what.

units.source_text: ‘夫人，请把小姐嫁给我吧。’我突然这样说道。

en.t: 'Madam, please let your daughter marry me,' I said suddenly.

units.source_text: 夫人虽然没有我想象的那么惊讶，但好一会儿也没有回答出话来，默默地望着我的脸。

en.t: Madam was not as surprised as I had imagined, but for a long while she could not answer and silently looked at my face.

units.source_text: 一旦开了口，我也就顾不上许多了，

en.t: Once I had begun speaking, I could no longer worry about anything else,

units.source_text: 面对着夫人望着我的眼睛，恳求道：‘把小姐嫁给我吧，请您一定要答应我！’

en.t: and facing Madam's eyes as she looked at me, I pleaded, 'Please let your daughter marry me. You must say yes!'

units.source_text: 还说：‘求求您，让小姐做我的妻子吧。’

en.t: I also said, 'Please, I beg you, let her become my wife.'

units.source_text: 夫人毕竟上了年岁，比我冷静得多，问道：‘嫁给你是可以的，不过也太急了些吧？’

en.t: Madam, being older after all, was much calmer than I was, and asked, 'I could let her marry you, but is this not rather sudden?'

units.source_text: 我赶紧答道：‘我是突然想要娶小姐的。’

en.t: I quickly answered, 'I suddenly want to marry her.'

units.source_text: 夫人听了笑了起来，然后问了一句：‘你是认真考虑过的吗？’

en.t: Madam laughed when she heard this, then asked, 'Have you thought this through seriously?'

units.source_text: 我不容置疑地辩称：‘虽然是突然提出来，但不是突然这么想的。’

en.t: I argued firmly, 'Although I brought it up suddenly, I did not begin thinking of it suddenly.'
